name: Augustin 'Ray' Reyes
background: A Redeemer pilot in the Luddite war; a launch accident grounded him for good. He runs the bar so he can stay with the fleet.
line: What'll it be, pilot? First one's on the house.

name: Adaeze Nwosu
background: Years with Homeland Security chasing pirates; cynical, and the deadliest shot in the squadron.
line: Bogeys at two o'clock. Let's dance!

name: Lin Mei
background: Grew up beside Rlaan traders and speaks some Rlaan; washed out of the medical corps and found her calm in the cockpit.
line: Stay sharp. The Aera never miss twice.

name: Kasia Wren
background: Her farming colony was lost in the first Aera push; she flies like it is personal, because it is.
line: Echo here. I've got your six.

name: Rafael Ortega
background: Got out of the Shmrn pocket on the last courier; he wants back in, and he wants the fleet to come with him.
line: Shmrn's still out there. We're going back.

name: Kenji Arai
background: Raised in a Shaper habitat; calm, curious, with reflexes that unsettle people.
line: Kestrel copies. Forming up on you.

name: Owen Price
background: Grew up on freighters, knows every engine by its sound, and bets on everything.
line: Ten credits says I bag more than you.

name: Wildcard (male)
background: Fresh from the academy: the pilot the player makes.

name: Wildcard (female)
background: Fresh from the academy: the pilot the player makes.

name: Cmdr. Mira Solberg
background: Survived the first Aera raids; hard but fair, and never forgets a name.
line: Your orders are on the board. Dismissed.

name: Chief Ana Kowalski
background: An ex-racer who got her callsign kitbashing racers out of scrapyard parts; now she keeps the wing flying on parts from three different ships, and tunes engines past spec.
line: Your bird's patched. Try not to scratch her.
